verified: OpenAI published a post stating that its models delivered up to 14% PPA improvement on AMD's flagship GPU IP in under five months, and that AMD incorporated changes into a design sent to production, as reported by The Decoder.
unconfirmed: The 14% figure and the "roughly a year's worth of progress" comparison rest on OpenAI's own account with no published baseline, benchmark methodology, or independent audit; neither the specific GPU IP, the manufacturing node, nor AMD's own confirmation of the number or the shipment timeline appears in the reports.

verified: OpenAI 在官方文章中声称，其模型在不到五个月内使 AMD 旗舰 GPU IP 的 PPA 最多改善 14%，并称 AMD 已将部分改动纳入一款送交制造的设计。
unconfirmed: 上述 14% 改善是否经过独立基准或第三方复测，比较基线、具体 GPU IP、制程节点，以及送交制造的设计是否已流片或量产，OpenAI 均未说明。

titles.en: OpenAI says its models lifted AMD flagship GPU PPA by up to 14%
titles.zh: OpenAI称模型让AMD旗舰GPU IP的PPA最多改善14%
